title: get Antonyms of Word
description:
Gets the antonyms (or opposites) of a word and stores them.
Can get multiple results, storing in a non-list variable/metadata tag will store only 1 of the results.

title: File properties
description: You can get file name, path, size and content

title: Hidden Players
description: The players hidden from a player that were hidden using the entity visibility effect.
syntax_pattern:
[(all [[of] the]|the)] hidden players (of|for) %players%
[(all [[of] the]|the)] players hidden (from|for|by) %players%

title: Experience
description: How much experience was spawned in an experience spawn or block break event. Can be changed.

title: On Group Receive Permission
description:
Called when a group receives a permission.
If the permission duration is infinite %event-timespan% will return 0 seconds.

`event-permission` = The permission the group received.
`event-group` = The group that received the permission.
`event-timespan` = The duration the group will have the permission for.

title: Experience Cooldown Change Reason
description: The experience change reason within an experience cooldown change event.

title: Experience Pickup Cooldown
description:
The experience cooldown of a player.
Experience cooldown is how long until a player can pick up another orb of experience.
The cooldown of a player must be 0 to pick up another orb of experience.

title: On Group Meta Set
description:
Called when the meta of a group is set.
Only called when meta is SET not unset etc for that case use `group meta remove`

`event-key` = The key e.g. "prefix" or "suffix"
`event-value` = The result that key was set to.
`event-group` = The group that received the meta.

title: ItemComponent - Consume Effect
description:
Represents an effect that is used in a consumable/death_protection item component.
There are 5 consume effects: apply_effects, remove_effects, clear_all_effects, teleport_randomly and play_sound.
Each of these has a function with the same name.

title: Lid Is Open/Closed
description: Check to see whether lidded blocks (chests, shulkers, etc.) are open or closed.
syntax_pattern:
[the] lid[s] of %blocks% (is|are) (open[ed]|close[d])
[the] lid[s] of %blocks% (isn't|is not|aren't|are not) (open[ed]|close[d])
%blocks%'[s] lid[s] (is|are) (open[ed]|close[d])
%blocks%'[s] lid[s] (isn't|is not|aren't|are not) (open[ed]|close[d])

title: Will Consume Boosting Firework
description: Checks to see if the firework used in an 'elytra boost' event will be consumed.
syntax_pattern:
[the] (boosting|used) firework will be consumed
[the] (boosting|used) firework (will not|won't) be consumed

title: Last Death Location
description:
Gets the last death location of a player, or offline player, if available.
Can also be set, reset, and deleted if the player is online.

title: Add Default Laby RPC
description: Edits the default LabyMod Discord RPC with custom Title

title: Floodgate  - Check that the player has logged in with Bedrock Edition
Player Chat Completions
description:
The custom chat completion suggestions. You can add, set, remove, and clear them. Removing the names of online players with this expression is ineffective.
This expression will not return anything due to Bukkit limitations.

title: Banner Pattern Item
description:
Gets the item from a banner pattern type.
Note that not all banner pattern types have an item.

title: Rainbow Glow
description: Make a player glow in a rainbow

title: Uses
description: Sets how many times a merchant recipe has been used.

title: Banner Pattern
description: Creates a new banner pattern.

title: Client Glow Off
description: Turn the client glow off

title: Give Skull by a nickname
description: Use Nickname of player for loading his textures in the custom skull.

title: Horse Domestication
description:
Gets and/or sets the (max) domestication of a horse.
The domestication of a horse is how close a horse is to becoming tame - the higher the domestication, the closer they are to becoming tame (must be between 1 and the max domestication level of the horse).
The max domestication of a horse is how long it will take for a horse to become tame (must be greater than 0).

title: Dispose Tab
description: Disables an advancement tab. This can be useful when a tab is registered after you remove an advancement tab creation section from a script.

title: AxisAngle/Quaternion/Vector(2D/3D/4D)/Location/EulerAngle/Chunk - XYZ(W) Coordinate/Coordinate List
description:
Gets a list or one of the coordinates of:
- Locations
- Vectors
- Chunks (only X and Z)
- EulerAngles
- 2D Vectors (only X and Z)
- 3D Vectors
- 4D Vectors (XYZW)
- Quaternions (XYZW)
- AxisAngles (XYZW)
- MapCursor

Note: Out of all of these Lusk only implements EulerAngles.

title: Bell - Resonating Time/Ticks
description:
Returns the time or ticks since one or more bells have been resonating, or 0 seconds for each bell that's not currently resonating.
A bell will typically resonate for 40 ticks (2 seconds)

Note: if you wish to use this expression on Skript 2.9+ you will need to use Lusk 1.3+.

title: Bell - Shaking Time/Ticks
description:
Returns the time or ticks since one or more bells have been shaking, or 0 seconds for each bell that's not currently resonating.
A bell will typically resonate for 50 ticks (2.5 seconds)

Note: if you wish to use this expression on Skript 2.9+ you will need to use Lusk 1.3+.

title: Item Flags
description: The item flags of an item. Can be modified.

title: Block/BlockData/BlockState/Item - Slipperiness
description:
Returns a value that represents how 'slippery' the block is.
Blocks with higher slipperiness, like ice can be slid on further by the player and other entities.
Most blocks have a default slipperiness of 0.6.

Can be used with items, blocks, blockstates, and blockdatas.

title: Bounding Box - Corners/Center
description:
Gets either the lesser or the greater corner or the lesser of one or more bounding boxes.

Returns vectors.

title: Item with Enchantment Glint
description: Get an item with or without enchantment glint.

title: Block - is Waterlogged (Property)
description:
Returns whether or not one or more blocks, blockstates or blockdatas are waterlogged.
Can be set.

title: Bounding Box - Entities Within
description: Gets all the entities within a bounding box in a specific world.

title: Citizen Wander
description: Whether a Citizens NPC has the Waypoints trait (wandering).

title: Permission Members
description:
Returns a list of UUIDS of users who have the specified permission.
Should be relatively fast depending on how many users have said permission.
syntax_pattern: set %objects% to (all|all of the) [luckperm[s]] (users|players) with perm[ission] %string%

title: Bounding Box - Corners/Center Coordinates
description: Gets the x,y or z coordinate for the lesser corner, the greater corner or the center of one or more bounding boxes.

title: Bounding Box - Height and Width X/Z
description: Gets the height, X width and Z width of 1 or more bounding boxes.

title: Owner of Head
description: Gets the owner of a player head.Will only work if the head is from a player.

title: Bounding Box - New Bounding Box
description: Creates a new empty Bounding Box, one from two corners or a copy of a given bounding box
syntax_pattern:
[a[n]] (new|[new] empty) bounding box
[a] [new] bounding box (between|from|using|with) %vector/location% (,|[,] and|to) %vector/location%
[a] [new [cloned|copied]|cloned|copied] bounding box from %boundingbox%

title: Island Contains
description: Check if locations are within the islands bounds.

title: Island Purge Protection
description:
Check if islands have purge protection.
BentoBox or ASkyBlock exclusive
syntax_pattern:
%islands% (is|are) purge protected
%islands% (isn't|is not|aren't|are not) purge protected

title: Challenge Completions
description: Returns the amount of completions a challenge has been done.

title: Challenge Name
description: Returns the name of the challenge.

title: Challenge Owner
description: Returns the owner of the challenge.

title: Island Creation Date
description:
Returns the creation date of the islands.
ASkyBlock exclusive

title: Island Members
description: Returns the members of the islands.

title: Island Name
description: Returns the names of the islands.

title: Player Island Home
description: Returns the island homes of the players.

title: Skyblock Challenges
description: Returns the challenges of a player.

title: Groups Of
description:
Represents the groups of a user.
This expression will require `luckperms` in it until Skript deprecates their `groups of`.

title: Make Glow
description: Make a player glow a color

title: Bounding Box - Volume
description: Gets the volume of 1 or more bounding boxes.

title: Make Blink
description: Make a player blink a color
syntax_pattern:
make %players% blink %glowcolor% with speed %effectspeed%
apply %glowcolor% blink with speed %effectspeed% to %players%

title: Entity Remove Cause
description:
Represents the reasons an entity was removed from the world.
NOTE: These are auto-generated and may differ between server versions, currently generated for Minecraft 26.3.
type_usage: death, despawn, discard, drop, enter_block, explode, hit, merge, out_of_world, pickup, player_quit, plugin, transformation, unload

title: Creation - Advancement Visibility
description: Sets the visibility of a custom advancement to visible, hidden, or visible when the parent is granted.

title: Visibility
description: Sets the visibility of a custom advancement.
type_usage: visible, shown, invisible, hidden, parent granted, parent is granted, is parent granted, parent

title: Unset/Unfake name and skin of player
description: Removes the fake name or skin of a player

title: Playing Song Note
description:
When a playingsong's note plays.
Cancelling will stop the note from playing.

title: Proxy Player's UUID
description: Returns the UUID of a given proxy player.

title: Reward
description: Sets the reward of a merchant recipe.

title: Regex matches
description: Checks if string matches a specific regex.

title: Groups of server
description: Gets all groups of the server

title: Server Brand
description: Set the server brand in the player's f3 page

title: Permissions Of
description: Represents the permissions of a user.

title: Is Proxy Server Online
description: Checks if a proxy server is online on the network.

title: Islands Of World
description: Returns the islands of the defined worlds.

title: Is Proxy Player Online
description: Checks if a proxy player is online on the network.

title: get Random Word
description:
Get a random word.
Due to api limitations you cannot retrieve a set amount of non english words, non english words with a set length or specify both amount and length.
Will send a warning if used to inform about this limitation, to disable the warning simply go to 'plugins/SkriptLanguage/config.yml', set 'randomWordWarning' to false, save and run /skriptlanguage (which is the config reload command as of 1.2.0).

title: Create Map
description: creates a new map

title: Send Proxy Player to Proxy Server
description: Sends a proxy player to another given proxy server.

title: Send Proxy Player Message
description: Sends proxy player(s) a message.

title: On Proxy Player Connect
description: When a proxy player joins the proxy.

title: On Proxy Player Disconnect
description: When a proxy player disconnects from the proxy.

title: On Proxy Player Kick
description: When a proxy player gets kicked from the proxy. (e.g. a ban)

title: On Proxy Server Message
description: When another server messages this server.

title: Network Variable
description: Represents a network variable which is synced between all servers. It can be set, added to, removed from or deleted - just like a regular variable.

title: All Proxy Servers
description: Returns all of the servers that are connected to your proxy.

title: Proxy Player's Current Server
description: Returns the given proxy player's current server.

title: Proxy Server's Player Limit
description: Returns the max player count of the given server. (defined in server.properties)

title: Current Proxy Server
description: Returns the name that the proxy assigned to this server.

title: Add Discord RPC with end time
description: Edits the default LabyMod Discord RPC with custom Title and an end time
syntax_pattern: create Discord RPC named %string% with end time of %integer% minutes for %player%

title: Send Proxy Server Message
description: Sends proxy server(s) a message. A corresponding event can be used to know when a server recieves one.

title: On Proxy Player Switch Server
description: When a proxy player switches to another server.

title: Set IP
description: Set the player's IP address
syntax_pattern: set ip of %player% to %string% with port %number%

title: PlotSquared | Inner Border Blocks
description:
Get the inner border blocks of a plot at a specified height

!! NO LONGER WORKS ON 1.1+ !!
syntax_pattern: [PlotSquared] [all] [inner] border blocks of plot [with id] %string% (at|with) height %number%

title: Any Named Thing
description: Something that has a name (e.g. an item).

title: Any Numbered/Sized Thing
description: Something that has an amount or size.

title: Anything with Contents
description: Something that contains other things.

title: Banner Pattern
description: Represents a banner pattern.

title: Attribute Modifier
description: Represents an attribute modifier from an item/living entity.

title: Banner Pattern Type
description: Represents the various banner patterns that can be applied to a banner.
type_usage: base, base banner pattern, border, border banner pattern, bordure banner pattern, bordure indented banner pattern, bottom left square banner pattern, bottom right square banner pattern, bottom stripe banner pattern, bottom triangle banner pattern, bricks, bricks banner pattern, center stripe banner pattern, circle, circle banner pattern, creeper, creeper banner pattern, creeper charged banner pattern, cross, cross banner pattern, curly border, curly border banner pattern, diagonal left, diagonal right, diagonal up left, diagonal up left banner pattern, diagonal up right, diagonal up right banner pattern, down left stripe banner pattern, down right stripe banner pattern, field masoned banner pattern, flow, flow banner pattern, flower, flower banner pattern, globe, globe banner pattern, gradient, gradient banner pattern, gradient up, gradient up banner pattern, guster, guster banner pattern, half horizontal, half horizontal bottom, half vertical, half vertical right, horizontal bottom half banner pattern, horizontal half banner pattern, left diagonal banner pattern, left stripe banner pattern, middle stripe banner pattern, mojang, mojang banner pattern, piglin, piglin banner pattern, rhombus, rhombus banner pattern, right diagonal banner pattern, right stripe banner pattern, right vertical half banner pattern, skull, skull banner pattern, small stripes, small stripes banner pattern, snout banner pattern, square bottom left, square bottom right, square top left, square top right, straight cross, straight cross banner pattern, stripe bottom, stripe center, stripe downleft, stripe downright, stripe left, stripe middle, stripe right, stripe top, tbottom triangles banner pattern, thing banner pattern, top left square banner pattern, top right square banner pattern, top stripe banner pattern, top triangle banner pattern, top triangles banner pattern, triangle bottom, triangle top, triangles bottom, triangles top, vertical half banner pattern

title: Spawn Fake Entity
description:
Spawn a client side entity.

### note
These entities do NOT exist on the server. So using normal syntax's will not work on them. You cannot set variables to them. You must use packets for ever kind of manipulation on them. See the metadata packet syntax.
syntax_pattern: spawn fake %entitytype% at %location% for %players% with id %number%

title: Fake Health
description: Change what the player sees for their health. Not to confuse this with health scaling, this is purely packet based

title: Group Weight
description:
Represents the weight of a group.

Note: This is deleted in 1.0.3

title: Guardian Beam/Laser
description:
Create a guardian beam for the player.

The colour is a string because I am lazy :D
*Do note, that if a colour is used, the guardian itself will glow. This sucks but cannot be made without an actual guardian. It does defeat the purpose of it but thought I would add the option anyways.*

*These are not persistent between reboots*
syntax_pattern: create a guardian laser from %location% to %location% [with color %string%] with id %string% for %players%

title: Stop Typewriter Cinematic
description: Stops the cinematic a player is watching. Does nothing when they are not in one.

title: Set Display Name of NPC (FancyNPCS)
description: Sets the display name of an NPC. You cannot use newlines in the display name.
syntax_pattern:
set %string%'s npc [display] name to %string%
set [the] display name of npc %string% to %string%

title: Fake Multi Block Change
description: Similar to Skript's *send block change* effect, this can do multiple blocks within a single packet. More efficient for larger scaled faking
syntax_pattern: fake multi block set %locations% as %blockdata% for %players%

title: Has Voice
description: Checks if one or more players are connected to voicechat.

title: Hostname
description: Similar to skript's hostname expression however, this works outside the player connect event. Making it easier to use.

title: Remove Client Entity
description:
Removes an entity from a client

This works for both fake and real entities
syntax_pattern: remove fake entity with id %numbers% for %players%

title: Block In Chunk
description:
Get the locations for specific blocks within a chunk

Faster than looping all blocks with Skript

*see https://pastebin.com/Fnt1xkNA for a test skript to show the performance differences*

title: Pitch of Note
description: The pitch of a Note

title: Open Merchant
description: Opens a merchant inventory to a player.

title: Merchant Recipe
description: Creates a new merchant recipe to be used in other expressions.

title: Trade of Merchant
description: Allows you to get or set a trade of a merchant inventory, typically represented by using `player's current inventory`.

title: All Trades of Merchant
description: Allows you to set, add, remove, delete, and reset trades of a merchant inventory.

title: Experience Reward
description: Allows you to set the experience reward of a merchant recipe.

title: Ignore Discounts
description: Allows you to make a merchant recipe ignore discounts or not.

title: Max Uses
description: Allows you to set the maximum uses of a merchant recipe. By default, there will be 999,999 max uses.

title: Villager Experience
description: Sets the amount of experience a villager gains when traded with.

title: Kick Proxy Player
description: Kicks / disconnects a given proxy player, with an optional message.
syntax_pattern: [(proxy|bungeecord|bungee|velocity) [player]] kick [(proxy|bungeecord|bungee|velocity)] %-proxyplayers% [(by reason of|because [of]|on account of|due to|with [reason]) %-string%]

title: Proxy Broadcast
description: Broadcasts a message to all players on the proxy, or on a specific server.

title: Proxy Player Execute Command
description: Makes a proxy player execute a given command (on the Spigot server).

title: Essentials Balance Change
description: Called upon Essentials balance change.

title: Primary Group of Player
description: Gets the primary group of an player

title: Bounding Box - of Entity/Block
description: Returns the bounding box of a block or an entity which reflects its location and size. (But not its world, kind of like vectors)

title: Script
description:
A script loaded by Skript.
Disabled scripts will report as being empty since their content has not been loaded.

title: Sound of note
description: The sound effect created by a note.

title: Proxy Server Execute Command
description: Makes a proxy server execute a command. Keep in mind, it's been executed from the console and has full permissions!

title: Reverse array
description: Reverses the elements of a list

title: On Citizen Left Click
description: Called when an NPC is left-clicked by a player.

title: On Citizen Right Click
description: Called when an NPC is right-clicked by a player.

title: On Citizen Select
description: Called when an NPC is selected by a player.

title: Teleport Flag
description: Teleport Flags are settings to retain during a teleport.
type_usage: passengers, xyz velocity, z velocity, yaw velocity, inventory, pitch velocity, vehicle, opened inventory, open inventory, x velocity, passenger, pitch and yaw velocity, yaw and pitch velocity, directional velocity, y velocity

title: Entity Knockback Cause
description: Represents the cause of knockback in an entity knockback event

title: Server Is Paused
description:
Checks whether the server is sleeping/paused.
The server is paused when no players have been online longer than `pause-when-empty-seconds` setting.
syntax_pattern:
server is paused
server (is not|isn't) paused

title: Set Player Skin
description:
Set a player's skin

### only use the signature when the `skin of` is a texture value
syntax_pattern: set skin of %players% to skin of %string% [with signature %-string%]

title: Structure - Template Exists
description:
Check if a structure template exists.
This can be helpful to prevent overriding structure templates.
syntax_pattern:
structure template %string% exists
structure template %string% (doesn't|does not) exist

title: Cat - is Lying Down (Property)
description:
Returns whether or not a cat is lying down.
Can be set and reset.
syntax_pattern:
[the] cat [is] lying down [state|property] of %livingentities%
%livingentities%'[s] cat [is] lying down [state|property]

title: Song's cutoff
description: The relative tick of the song where it will finish / loop.

title: On Armor Dispense
description: Called when an equippable item is dispensed from a block and equipped on a nearby entity.

title: On Bell Ring
description: Called when a bell is rung.

title: Chicken - is Chicken Jockey (Property)
description: Checks if the provided chickens are chicken jockeys.

title: Fox - Trusted Players
description:
Returns the first, second, or both trusted players of 1 or more foxes.

*NOTES*:
- The first and second trusted players can both be set to a single `offline player`, the trusted players can be set to 2 offline players (or 1, which only sets the first one).
- The second trusted player must be set after the first one, which also means you can't clear the first one if the second one is set, both actions will fail silently.
- If you wish to set/clear both, do so by using the second pattern: `clear trusted players of {_fox}`
syntax_pattern:
[the] ([first|second] trusted player|trusted players) of %livingentities%
%livingentities%'[s] ([first|second] trusted player|trusted players)

title: Structure - Template Fill
description: Fill a structure template with blocks from the world.

title: Listeners of Playing Song
description: All of the listeners of a playing song.

title: On Furnace Extract
description: This event is called when a player takes items out of the furnace.
event_values: event-slot, event-itemtype, event-integer, event-block, event-world, event-inventory, event-location

title: On Post Respawn
description:
This event requires Paper.

Fired after a player has respawned.

title: On Pre Compost Event
description:
This event requires Paper.

Called when an item is about to be composted by an entity.

title: On Pre Damage Event
description:
This event requires Paper.

Called when the player tries to attack an entity. This occurs before any of the damage logic, so cancelling this event will prevent any sort of sounds from being played when attacking. This event will fire as cancelled for certain entities, use the "will be damaged" condition to check if the entity will not actually be attacked.
Note: there may be other factors (invulnerability, etc) that will prevent this entity from being attacked that this event will not cover.

title: On Hopper Compost Item
description:
This event requires Paper.

Called when an item is about to be composted by a hopper.
To prevent hoppers from moving items into composters, cancel the Inventory move event from SkBee.

title: On Main Hand Switch
description: Called when a player changes their main hand in the client settings.

title: Add Laby RPC with timer
description: Edits the default LabyMod Discord RPC with custom Title and a new timer
syntax_pattern: create Discord RPC named %string% with timer for %player%

title: On Furnace Start Smelting
description: Called when a Furnace starts smelting.

title: Get Active-Model
description: returns a active-model from a uuid

title: Will Raise Composter Level
description:
This Condition requires Paper.

Checks whether or not the composter's level will rise in a Compost Item Event
syntax_pattern:
[the] composter level will be raised
[the] composter level w(ill no|on')t be raised

title: Structure - Template Place
description:
Place an already created structure template into the world.
Palette = The palette index of the structure to use, starting at 0, or -1 to pick a random palette.
A palette represents a variation of a structure template.
Most structure templates, like the ones generated with structure blocks, only have a single variant.

title: Should Trigger Advancements
description:
This Condition requires Paper.

Checks whether or not the Slot Change event should trigger advancements.
syntax_pattern:
[the] event will trigger [any] advancements
[the] event w(ill not|on't) trigger [any] advancements

title: Will Be Damaged
description:
This Condition requires Paper.

Checks whether or not the entity in the Pre Damage Event will be damaged.
syntax_pattern:
[the] entity will be (damaged|attacked)
[the] entity w(ill not|on't) be (damaged|attacked)

title: Citizens - is NPC
description: Checks if an entity is an NPC. (Citizens)

title: Fox - is Defending
description: Checks if the fox is defending.
syntax_pattern:
fox[es] %livingentities% (is|are) defending
fox[es] %livingentities% (isn't|is not|aren't|are not) defending

title: Fox - is Faceplanted
description: Checks if the fox is faceplanted.

title: Fox - is Leaping
description: Checks if a fox is leaping.

title: Player - is Crawling
description: Checks if a player is crawling.

title: is Bed Respawn
description:
Deprecated since 2.7: https://docs.skriptlang.org/nightly/master/docs.html?search=#CondRespawnLocation

This Condition requires Paper.

Checks whether or not the player in the Post Respawn event has respawned at they bed.
syntax_pattern:
[the] player will respawn at [their] bed
[the] player w(on't|ill not) respawn at [their] bed

title: On Warden Anger Change
description:
This event requires Paper.

Called when a Warden's anger level has changed due to another entity.

If the event is cancelled, the warden's anger level will not change.

title: Fox - is Crouching
description: Checks if a fox is crouching.

title: is Placing in Pot
description:
This Condition requires Paper.

Checks whether or not the item is being placed inside the flower pot in a Flower Pot Manipulate Event.
syntax_pattern:
[the] (flower|plant|item) is being (placed|picked up)
[the] (flower|plant|item) is(n't| not) being (placed|picked up)

title: Cancel Composter Level Rise
description:
This Effect requires Paper.

Can only be used in a Compost Item Event.
Sets whether or not the composter's level should rise.

title: Best Equipment Slot
description: Returns the best Slot for an item.
syntax_pattern:
[the] best equipment slot of %itemtypes%
%itemtypes%'[s] best equipment slot

title: Item Rarity - Color
description:
Returns the color of an item's rarity.
Can be used with the item itself and it will get its rarity's color without getting the rarity itself if you don't need it.

title: Equipment Slots
description: Returns all the equipment slots.

title: Fox - is Defending (Property)
description: Gets whether the provided foxed are defending, can be set and reset.

title: Show Credits
description: Shows a player the win screen that normally is only displayed after one kills the ender dragon and exits the end for the first time.

title: Enchantment - Maximum Level
description: Returns the Maximum Vanilla Level for an Enchantment.
syntax_pattern:
[the] [vanilla] max[imum] enchant[ment] level of %enchantments%
%enchantments%'[s] [vanilla] max[imum] enchant[ment] level

title: Item - Rarity
description:
Returns the rarity of an item.
Can be set.

Before Lusk 1.2 (and Minecraft 1.20.5), this expression returned strings and also worked for enchantments, due to some major changes enchantments no longer have a rarity.

title: Block - Blast Resistance
description:
Obtains the blast resistance value (also known as block "durability").
This value is used in explosions to calculate whether a block should be broken or not.

Only works for placeable item/blocks.

title: Dye Event - Dye Color
description:
Returns the applied color in the Dye event.
 This expression can be set to another dye color.

title: Enchantment - Minimum Level
description: Returns the Minimum Vanilla Level for an Enchantment.
syntax_pattern:
[the] [vanilla] min[imum] enchant[ment] level of %enchantments%
%enchantments%'[s] [vanilla] min[imum] enchant[ment] level

title: Loom Pattern Type
description: Gets the pattern type selected in a Loom Pattern Select event

title: Server Pause When Empty Time
description:
Represents the pause when empty threshold seconds.
To save resources, the server will pause most functions after this time if there are no players online.
Delete will disable this setting.
If the returned value is null that means the setting is disabled.

title: Version - from String
description: Gets a version from a string.

title: Fox - is Faceplanted (Property)
description: Gets whether the provided foxes are faceplanted, if running Paper this can be set and reset.

title: Fake Username ~ OUTDATED
description:
Change the overhead name of the player. Not the prefix or suffix the **ACTUAL** username of the player. This is limited by the clients 16 character max characters. But it does support colour (&) *(it does use characters up though)* 

You can make it so different players see different names per person. As all packets this is not persistent.

*As of now this is only supported on* **1.19.3/4** *servers due to Mojang's mapping and ClientboundInfo packets*

title: Fake Item/Equipment
description:
Make a player see your armour and holding items as different to what they are. This works for mobs too.

You can use an entity id instead of an entity for fake entities

For the string use any of the following:
**HAND**
**OFF_HAND**
**HEAD**
**CHEST**
**LEGS**
**FEET**

title: Item Frame - Item (Silently Set)
description:
Gets a copy of the item in the provided item frames.
Can be set and deleted, this expression supports the Silent Section, see examples.

title: Item Frame - Item Drop Chance
description:
The chance of the item being dropped upon this item frame's destruction.
Can be set, removed from, added to, reset (1) and deleted (0).

The final value is always clamped between 0 and 1.

1 = always drops; 0 = never drops.
syntax_pattern:
[the] item[ |-]frame [item] drop chance of %entities%
%entities%'[s] item[ |-]frame [item] drop chance

title: Warden - Anger
description:
Returns the anger of a warden.

Angry = 80 or above
Agitated = 40-79
Calm = 0-39

Use the respective conditions to check for those 3 states.

title: Reset Laby RPC
description: Resets the Discord RPC to laby default

title: Floodgate - Open the form to the player
Fox - is Leaping (Property)
description: Gets whether the provided foxed are leaping, can be set and reset.

title: Item - Supported/Preferred Enchantments
description: Returns the Enchantments this item can normally have.

title: Jukebox - Record/Disc
description:
Returns the music disc within a jukebox.
Can be set, reset and deleted.

title: Llama - Strength
description:
Returns the provided llamas' strength.
A higher strength llama will have more inventory slots and be more threatening to entities.

Can be set.

Must be between 1 and 5.

title: Item Frame - is Visible / is Invisible (Property)
description:
Gets whether the item frame is visible or not.
Can be set.

title: Player - Previous Game Mode
description: Returns the previous gamemode of a player.

title: Contains
description: Checks whether an inventory contains an item, a text contains another piece of text, a container contains something, or a list (e.g. {list variable::*} or 'drops') contains another object.
syntax_pattern:
%inventories% (has|have) %itemtypes% [in [(the[ir]|his|her|its)] inventory]
%inventories% (doesn't|does not|do not|don't) have %itemtypes% [in [(the[ir]|his|her|its)] inventory]
%inventories/strings/objects% contain[(s)] %itemtypes/strings/objects%
%inventories/strings/objects% (doesn't|does not|do not|don't) contain %itemtypes/strings/objects%

title: Creeper/Primed TNT/TNT Minecart - Max/Regular Fuse Time/Ticks
Crossbow - Charged Projectiles
description:
Returns the Projectile Items charged in the provided crossbows.
Can be set, added to, removed from, reset and deleted.
syntax_pattern:
[the] charged projectiles (in|of) %itemtypes%
[the] projectiles charged in %itemtypes%
%itemtypes%'[s] charged projectiles

title: Enchanted Book - Stored Enchantments
description:
Returns the Enchantments stored in an enchanted book.
Can be set, added to, removed from, reset and deleted.
syntax_pattern:
[the] enchantment[ type]s stored in %itemtypes%
[the] stored enchantment[ type]s of %itemtypes%
%itemtypes%'[s] stored enchantment[ type]s

title: End Crystal - Beam Target
description:
Gets the location that the provided end crystals are pointing their beam to.
Can be set, if the provided location is in a different world it will fail silently.
syntax_pattern:
[the] [end[er] crystal] beam target [location] of %entities%
%entities%'[s] [end[er] crystal] beam target [location]

title: Connection
description: Connect to your email account.

title: Last Emails
description: Return last received mails in a box.

title: Email Service
description: A email service like Gmail. Store smtp and imap, port and address.

title: Registry - Tag Key
description:
Represents a key for a Minecraft tag.
TagKeys can also compare if it contains objects (Think of them like a list).

title: Attribute Type
description:
Represents the type of an attribute. Note that this type does not contain any numerical values.See attribute types for more info.
NOTE: Minecraft namespaces are supported, ex: 'minecraft:generic.attack_damage'.
type_usage: air drag modifier, armor, armor toughness, armour, armour toughness, attack damage, attack knockback, attack speed, below name distance, block break speed, block interaction range, bounciness, burning time, camera distance, entity interaction range, explosion knockback resistance, fall damage multiplier, flying speed, follow range, friction modifier, generic armor, generic armor toughness, generic armour, generic armour toughness, generic attack damage, generic attack knockback, generic attack speed, generic burning time, generic explosion knockback resistance, generic fall damage multiplier, generic flying speed, generic follow range, generic gravity, generic jump strength, generic knockback resistance, generic luck, generic max absorption, generic max health, generic movement efficiency, generic movement speed, generic oxygen bonus, generic safe fall distance, generic scale, generic step height, generic tempt range, generic water movement efficiency, gravity, horse jump strength, jump strength, knockback resistance, luck, max absorption, max health, mining efficiency, movement efficiency, movement speed, name tag distance, name tag score visibility distance, name tag visibility distance, nameplate score visibility distance, nameplate visibility distance, oxygen bonus, player block break speed, player block interaction range, player entity interaction range, player mining efficiency, player sneaking speed, player submerged mining speed, player sweeping damage ratio, safe fall distance, scale, sneaking speed, spawn reinforcements, step height, submerged mining speed, sweeping damage ratio, tempt range, water movement efficiency, waypoint receive range, waypoint transmit range, zombie spawn reinforcements

title: Telegram Sender of Message
description: The sender of a Telegram Message.

title: On Citizen Spawn
description: Called when an NPC spawns.

title: Citizen Despawn/Respawn
description:
Despawning a citizen will remove it from the world, but won't deregister it.
Respawning a citizen will spawn it back into the world.

title: Is Navigating
description: Checks if a citizen is currently navigating

title: Villager Wakeup
description: Causes villagers to wake up if they're currently sleeping.

title: Wolf Angry
description: Get if a wolfie is angry.
syntax_pattern:
set angry of %livingentities% to %boolean%
set %livingentities%'[s] angry to %boolean%

title: Dripstone Thickness
description: Get the thickness of a dripstone.

title: GPT Completion Request
description:
Generate a completion of an input string using the OpenAI ChatGPT API, based on an input prompt.
ATTENTION! This syntax does not use the ChatGPT endpoint. You won't receive back a conversation from the AI, just a chat completion. It will try to predict what the message is, it won't respond as an assistant.
syntax_pattern:
(generate|make) [a] [gpt] completion with (prompt|input) %string% [and model %-string%] [and max tokens %-number%] [and temperature %-number%]
(generate|make) [a] [gpt] completion with (prompt|input) %string% [and model %-string%] [and max tokens %-number%] [and temperature %-number%] without echo

title: GPT Chat Completion Request
description: Generate a response to a prompt string using the OpenAI ChatGPT API, based on an input prompt.
syntax_pattern:
(generate|make) [a] chat[gpt] completion with (prompt|input) %string% [and model %-string%] [and max tokens %-number%] [and temperature %-number%]
(generate|make) [a] chat[gpt] completion with conversation %conversationmessages% [and model %-string%] [and max tokens %-number%] [and temperature %-number%]

title: GPT Content of Conversation Message
description: Returns the content of a conversation message.

title: GPT Role of Conversation Message
description: Returns a string, which indicates the sender of the message. The role can only be either "system", "user" or "assistant".

title: Generated Prompt
description: Returns the last generated response from a Chat Completion request. Call this immediately after sending a new chatgpt prompt, and save it into a variable.

title: New Conversation Message
description: Returns a conversation message type with a role and an empty content. if the [with role] part of the syntax is not specified, defaults to user.

title: Conversation Message
description: This type holds information about a message in a conversation with ChatGPT. It has two main parts, the role (which can only be set to "assistant", "system" or "user") and the content, which is basically whatever string the user or the AI want to send.
type_usage:
send "%conversationmessage%" #implicitly converting it into a string will show its content.
set {_c} to %string% parsed as conversation message #builds a string with default role "user"
generate chat completion with conversation %conversationmessages% #Use conversation persistence.

title: Trail
description:
Creates a new trail to be used with 'trail' particle.
Takes in a location for the target (where the trail heads to), the color and duration.
Requires Minecraft 1.21.4+
syntax_pattern: trail(target: location, color: color, duration: time span)

title: Entity ID
description: Get the entity id of an entity

title: Proxy Players
description: Gets all of the proxy players. You can also specify a specific server if you would like to get the players from there if you need to.

title: Using Network Variable
description:
Gets a network variable async and allows you to use it in this section. 
You can only get one network variable per section.

title: Ender Signal - Despawn Time/ticks
description:
Gets how long the provided ender signals have been alive for.
Can be set.
Either as ticks or a timespan.
When greater than 80 ticks (or 4 seconds), it will despawn on the next tick.

title: On Brew
description: Called when a Brewing Stand brews.

title: On Bell Resonate
description:
Called when a bell resonated after being rung and highlights nearby raiders.
A bell will only resonate if raiders are in the vicinity of the bell.

title: Ender Signal - Item
description: Gets the item the provided ender signals will display and drop on death.

title: Item - Can Be Enchanted with
description:
Checks if an item can be enchanted with an Enchantment.
This does not check if the enchantment conflicts with any enchantments already applied on the item.
syntax_pattern:
%itemtype% can be enchanted with %enchantment%
%itemtype% can('|no)t be enchanted with %enchantment%

title: Allay - can Be Duplicated
description: Checks if an allay can be duplicated.
syntax_pattern:
[allay[s]] %entities% can be duplicated
[allay[s]] %entities% (can't|cannot|can not) be duplicated

title: Enderman - Has Been Looked At
description: Checks if an enderman has been looked at.

%livingentity% has been (looked|stared) at
%livingentity% has(n't| not) been (looked|stared) at

title: Entity - is Angry
description:
Checks if an entity is angry.
(Warden, PigZombie, Wolf, Enderman)

title: Entity - is In Powdered Snow
description: Checks if an entity is in powdered snow.
syntax_pattern:
%entity% (is|are) in powdered snow
%entity% (isn't|is not|aren't|are not) in powdered snow

title: Entity - is Screaming
description:
Checks if an entity is screaming.
(Enderman, Goat)

title: On Enderman Decide
description:
This event requires Paper.

Fired when an Enderman determines if it should attack a player or not.
Starts off cancelled if the player is wearing a pumpkin head or is not looking at the Enderman, according to Vanilla rules.

title: On Ender Dragon Change Phase
description: Called when an EnderDragon switches phase.
syntax_pattern:
[on] ender dragon change phase
[on] ender dragon phase change 
[on] ender dragon phase

title: On Pre Dispense
description:
This event requires Paper.

Called when a block is about to dispense an item.

title: On Entity Enter Love Mode
description:
Called when an entity enters love mode.
This can be cancelled but the item will still be consumed that was used to make the entity enter into love mode.

title: On Sleep Fail
description:
This Event requires Paper.

Called when a player attempts to sleep but fails..

title: On Pose Change
description: Called when an entity changes its pose.

title: In The Past/Future
description:
Checks whether a date is in the past or future.
Note that using the 'now' expression will not be in the past or future when used directly in the condition.
syntax_pattern:

%dates% ha(s|ve)[(n't| not)] passed

title: On Elder Guardian Appear
description: Called when an ElderGuardian appears in front of a Player.

title: On Dispense Fail
description:
This event requires Paper.

Called when a block tries to dispense an item, but its inventory is empty.

title: Ocelot - is Trusting
description: Checks if an ocelot trusts players.

title: Warden - is Agitated
description: Checks if a Warden is agitated.

title: Warden - is Calm
description: Checks if a Warden is calm.

title: Entity - Can Sit
description: Checks if an entity can normally sit.

title: Cancel Advancements
description:
This Effect requires Paper.

Can only be used in a Slot Change Event.
Sets whether or not the event should trigger advancements.

title: Voice Rules
description: Gets, sets, adds or removes voice recognition rules (phrases) for a specific player.

title: Wake Up
description: Wakes a player/villager up.

[the] whitelist is disabled

title: Villager - Zombify

description: Forces an allay to duplicate itself without dance or item necessary.

title: Cancel Consuming Brewing Fuel
description: Sets whether the fuel of the brewing stand in the Brewing Stand Fuel Event will be reduced / consumed.

description: Checks whether or not the brewing stand's fuel will be consumed in a Brewing Stand Fuel Event

title: Entity - is Underwater
description: Checks if an entity is underwater.

description: Forces an Allay to start/stop dancing.

%entities% (isn't|is not|aren't|are not) [a] spawner entity

title: Enforce Whitelist
description: Sets if the whitelist is enforced.

title: Enderman - Randomly Teleport
description: Attempts to teleport an enderman to a random nearby location.

description: Checks whether the whitelist is enforced. If the whitelist is enforced, non-whitelisted players will be disconnected when the server whitelist is reloaded.

[the] whitelist is not enforced

title: WorldBorder - Change is Instant

This Condition requires Paper.

Checks whether or not the worldborder change is instant in the worldborder change event

title: Warden - Disturb

title: Toggle Whitelist
description: Sets if the server is whitelisted.

title: Do Nothing...
description:
Does nothing.
Useful as a placeholder.

title: Ender Signal - Target Location
description:
Gets the location the provided ender signals are moving towards.
When set, the drop chance resets to a random value and the despawn timer gets set back to 0.

%entities%'[s] ender (signal|eye) target location

 Can be set.

title: Item - Unenchanted/Disenchanted
description: Returns one or more items without enchantments.

title: On Cauldron Level Change
description: Called when a Cauldron's level changes.'

description:
Returns the love duration of an animal.
 Can be set.

title: Player - Previous Gamemode

title: Ocelot - is Trusting (Property)
description:
Returns whether or not an ocelot trusts players.
Can be set.

title: Enderman - Held Block Data
description: Returns the Held Block Data of the provided Endermen.

title: Block - Slipperiness
description:
Returns a value that represents how 'slippery' the block is. Blocks with higher slipperiness, like ice can be slid on further by the player and other entities.
Most blocks have a default slipperiness of 0.6.

Only works for placeable item/blocks.

title: On Enderman Escape

This event requires Paper.

Called when an enderman escapes.

CRITICAL_HIT: The enderman has teleported away due to a critical hit
DROWN: Specific case for CRITICAL_HIT where the enderman is taking rain damage
INDIRECT: The enderman has teleported away due to indirect damage (ranged)
RUNAWAY: The enderman has stopped attacking and ran away
STARE: The enderman has teleported away due to the player staring at it during combat

title: Dolphin - Treasure Chest Location

Gets the treasure location the provided dolphins try to guide players to.

This value is calculated if the player has fed the dolphin a fish (which Lusk includes), `DOLPHIN_SWIM_TO_TREASURE` goal.

Can be set, but it only has an effect if the dolphin is currently leading a player, as this value is recalculated next time it leads a player.

The world of the location you give it does not matter, as the dolphin will always use the world it is currently in.

Fired when an entity is pushed by another entity's attack.
The acceleration vector can be modified. If this event is cancelled, the entity will not get pushed.

Note: Some entities might trigger this multiple times on the same entity as multiple acceleration calculations are done.

description: Send an action bar to the specified player(s).

title: Cache object
description: Caches an object making it retrievable by the specified key. Will remain in cache until server is stopped or the cache has been deleted.

title: Armor and inventory
description: Returns a list of all the players inventory and armor (full equipment).
syntax_pattern:
%player%'s inventory and armor
%player%'s armor and inventory
%player%'s full equipment

title: Cache data
description: Caches an object to be retrieved at a later time.

title: Index by value
description: Finds the index by value in a variable.

title: Regex replace
description: Regex replaces in the specified string

title: Regex split
description: Splits a string by the specified regex-pattern.

title: Sort
description: Sorts a list variable. Can be passed a helper function to sort better.

title: Data of sorted node
description: Retrieves data from the nodes that the sorted-syntax (https://skripthub.net/docs/?id=9187) makes.
syntax_pattern:
index of %topnode%
value of %topnode%
location of %topnode%

title: On Player link
description: Fired when a Player successfully links.

title: Skeleton Horse - Trap Time
description: Returns the trap time of the skeleton horse.
syntax_pattern:
[the] skeleton horse trap[ped] time of %livingentity%
%livingentity%'[s] skeleton horse trap[ped] time

title: Telegram Bot Login
description: Create a session and authenticate to a telegram bot, given its username and its token.
syntax_pattern: telegram login to bot %string% with token %string%

title: Clear all telegram sessions
description: Close all the telegram sessions that are active. Stops any running bot. You should use this in case you get an api error 409 saying multiple instances are running a single bot. Please note that closing a session may take up to 50 seconds, as it is delayed by the Telegram API itself.

title: Telegram Message
description: This type holds all the information about a message. You can either get this object in a telegram event (event-telegram message) or by creating a new one (new telegram message with text %string%)

title: Telegram Chat
description: This type holds all the information about a telegram chat.
type_usage:
type of %telegramchat%
id of %telegramchat%

title: Telegram Inline Keyboard
description: This type represents a Telegram Inline Keyboard. A keyboard is a matrix of buttons (double list). You can access the rows of the keyboard with the row expression.
type_usage:
1st row of keyboard %inlinekeyboard%
inline keyboard of %telegrammessage%

title: Telegram Inline Button
description:
This type represents a Telegram Inline Button. You can't add simply the button to a message, but you need first to add it into a keyboard. You can then add the keyboard to the message. (Otherwise, how would Telegram know which position the button would have to be?)

Of a button, you can define its text (the displayed button itself) and its action. If you set its URL, it will open automatically a link when clicked. If you set its callback data, you can specify the data that is sent to the bot when clicked. You can listen to such data with the EvtCallbackQuery
type_usage:
text of %inlinebutton%
callback data of %inlinebutton%
url of %inlinebutton%

title: Telegram Message Event
description: Fires whenever a message (or command) is received. You can access the received message with event-telegram message

title: Telegram CallbackQuery Event
description: Fires whenever a button with a callback data is fired. You can specify for which data to listen or leave it blank to listen for any button press
event_values:
event-callback query
event-telegram user
event-telegram message
event-telegram bot

title: Callback Query
description: This type represents a Callback Query. A callback query is what the bot receives when an inline button is pressed. You can see for example the callback data of the button with callback data of %callbackquery%
type_usage: event-callback query

title: New Telegram Message
description: Returns a new empty telegram message. You can use other expressions to change its properties, such as text, keyboard, etc. You may use this outside of a Telegram Event, but in order to send it you'll have to specify bot you are using.

title: Last Telegram Sent Message
description: Returns the last sent message. Use this exclusively and immediately after sending a message.

title: Telegram Chat of Message
description: Returns a Telegram Chat type. The chat in which a message has been sent. Can not be set.

title: Telegram Text of Message
description: Returns the text of a telegram message. Can be changed to edit the message.

title: Send telegram message
description: Send a telegram message. The message can be a string or can be an existing message. The target chat ID can be used to specify the destination of the message. If used inside of a Telegram Event, the bot to use is automatically detected. To use it outside of a Telegram Event, specify the username of the bot. If a session exists for that bot, the message will be sent.
syntax_pattern: send telegram message %string/telegrammessage% [with markdown] to %telegramuser/telegramchat/number% [with bot %string%]

title: Reply telegram message
description: Send a telegram message, as a reply to another message. The reply message can be a string or can be an existing message. If used inside of a Telegram Event, the bot to use is automatically detected. To use it outside of a Telegram Event, specify the username of the bot. If a session exists for that bot, the message will be sent.
syntax_pattern: reply to telegram message %telegrammessage% with %telegrammessage/string% [with markdown] [with bot %-string%]

title: Telegram Id
description: Returns the Numeric ID of a telegram object. Each user has an unique ID. The ID of a chat is identic to a user ID if it's its private chat with the bot. (It is different if it's a group or supergroup etc.). Each message has an unique ID inside of a chat. Can't be set.
syntax_pattern:
id of %telegrammessage%
id of %telegramuser%
id of %telegramchat%

title: Telegram Chat Type
description: Returns the type of a telegram chat. It can be "PRIVATE", "BOT", "GROUP", "SUPERGROUP" or "CHANNEL". Can't be set.

title: Callback Data of InlineButton
description: The callback data of an Inline Button. This is the text that is sent to the bot on a button press, and it can be listened for with the On Callback Query event.

title: Callback Data of CallbackQuery
description: The callback data of a Callback Query. You can use this to check what telegram button was pressed, based on the callback data you had set.

title: Text of InlineButton
description: The Displayed text of an Inline Button. This is the actual message a button has in the chat.

title: Url of InlineButton
description: The URL of an Inline Button. Note that a button can't have both a callback data and an URL. The link will be opened on button press.

title: Row of InlineKeyboard
description: The row of an existing InlineKeyboard. You can add, remove, set and clear rows. Setting a row that doesn't exist on the keyboard will simply append it to the bottom.

title: Inline Keyboard of Message
description: The Inline Keyboard of a Telegram Message. You can use this to add a keyboard to existing messages, before sending them.

title: Telegram User
description: This type represents a Telegram User.
type_usage: id of %telegramuser%

title: Clear Telegram Session
description: Closes the telegram session of a specific bot. Please note that closing a session may take up to 50 seconds, as it is delayed by the Telegram API itself.

title: Telegram Bot
description: This type represents a telegram bot. It holds information about the bot that fired a spefific event. You can view its username (to check if the bot is the one you're creating in skript) with "%username of event-telegram bot%" or with "%event-telegram bot%" Since Telegram Events are fired by all bots ran on a server, you should always filter that the received event is fired by the bot you're programming.
type_usage: event-telegram bot

title: Answer to Callback Query
description: Show a little notification to a user after they pressed a button. This will also complete a button press, removing the little clock that shows on the button when it gets pressed. Adding "with popup" will show the callback query answer in a popup window, and the user will have to press OK to hide it.
syntax_pattern: answer to callback query %callbackquery% with %string% [with popup]

title: Forward Telegram Message
description: Forward an existing telegram message, and send it to a user. The final message will have information about who sent it in the first place. It will show "forwarded from" to its top.

title: Copy Telegram Message
description: Copy an existing telegram message, and send it to a user. This is useful for storing messages sent by the bot, eg. media or other. A copied message will not have "forwarded from" to its top.

title: Telegram Username of User / Chat / Bot
description: The username (mention) of a telegram user, a chat, or a bot. The username is returned without the @. If no username is set, null is returned.

title: Telegram Full Name of User / Chat
description: The full name of a Telegram User or, if a Chat, the title of the chat.

title: Telegram Language Code of User
description: The language code (IT, EN, FR ... ) of a telegram user, as set in the settings by them.

title: Edit Telegram Message
description: Edit an existing, sent telegram message to a new one or to a string.
syntax_pattern: edit telegram message %telegrammessage% to %telegrammessage/string% [with markdown] [with bot %string%]

title: Telegram Replied Message of a Message
description: Returns a Message object containing another message, the one that the original was in reply to. Cannot be set (to send messages as a reply, use the proper effect)

title: On vote
description: Fires when a player votes for the server on a voting site.
event_values: event-vote username, event-vote service, event-vote address, event-vote timestamp

title: New Anvil GUI
description: Returns a new anvil gui. If no title and default text are specified, it will use some placeholder text. If  you choose to specify the name or the text, you have to specify both.
syntax_pattern:
new anvil gui
[a] new anvil gui (named|with title) %string% with [default] text %string%

title: Anvil GUI
description: This type holds all the information about an AnvilGUI inventory. You can create a new object with the new anvil gui expression and edit its content (such as the items) with the specific expressions.
type_usage: This type holds all the information about an AnvilGUI inventory.

title: Combuster
description: Returns the combuster of the event, either a block or an entity.

title: Current Steerable Boost
description: Get the current boost time of a steerable entity such as a pig or strider. This can be added, set or removed.

title: Dripstone Directions
description: Get the directions of a dripstone.

title: Anvil GUI Text
description: Access the default text of an AnvilGUI. This will be filled when the anvil is opened to a player.

title: Anvil GUI Title
description: Access the title (inventory name) of an Anvil GUI. In 1.12.2, the name of the AnvilGUI will not change when displayed. This is not really an issue (other than for aesthetic) as the title is still saved and can be accessed (to check for specific anvil GUIs in events).

title: Anvil GUI Close
description: Fires whenever an anvil gui created with this addon is closed. You can access the following values from this event: event-text (content of the GUI when the GUI was closed), event-anvil gui (the original anvil object. You can access items in the anvil GUI or its inventory title with expressions below.)
event_values:
event-text (Text input in the ANVIL)
event-virtual anvil (Original opened anvil)

title: Open Anvil GUI
description: Open an Anvil GUI to a player. Note that once the AnvilGUI is opened to a player, you can't change it "live" while it's being shown. Therefore you first must set the slots of the GUI, and then open it to the player.

title: Anvil GUI Click
description: Fires whenever an anvil gui created with this addon is clicked. You can access the following values from this event: event-integer (index of slot that was clicked), event-text (content of the GUI when the GUI was clicked), event-anvil gui (the original anvil object. You can access items in the anvil GUI or its inventory title with expressions below.)
event_values:
event-integer (ID of clicked slot)
event-text (Text input in the ANVIL)
event-virtual anvil (Original opened anvil)

title: Remove Subtitle
description: Removes the subtitle of the player if one is present.

Called when a player loads an entity, not when an entity is added to a world. This is a packet event.

Useful for sending packets for things like metadata and ect.

description: Converts a list variable to a wrapped list.

Files - Name of a file or directory

title: location
description:
Creates a location from a world and 3 coordinates, with an optional yaw and pitch.
If for whatever reason the world is not found, it will fallback to the server's main world.
syntax_pattern: location(x: number, y: number, z: number, world: world = event-world, yaw: number = 0, pitch: number = 0)

title: Location of PlayingSong
description:
The location of a PlayingSong.
If it is null, then the song will play in front of the player.

title: Integer Range
description:
Represents a range between 2 integers.
Use the IntegerRange expression to get the high/low value.

title: IntegerRange - Low/High
description: Get the low/high point of an integer range.

title: Brig Command Arg
description:
Represents the arguments in a Brig Command. These works the same way as Skript's `arg` and `arg-1`.
Since command args create local variables at runtime, these are virtually useless.
These can be used in both the `register argument` and `trigger` sections.

description: Expression that returns the permission added or removed in a Permission add/remove event.

title: Group

title: Cell Column/Row
description: Represents the column/row of a cell (essentially the offset from the base).

title: Cell Offset
description: Get the offset of a cell in Vector form.

title: Cells of Maze
description: Get a list of cells of a maze.

title: Maze - Create

Create a new maze. Height/Width needs to be greater than 3 and should be odd numbers.
The first pattern (just size) will create a maze with the same height/width.

[a] [new] maze with height %number% and width %number%
